title: astragalus flexuosus var. diehlii
intro: Astragalus flexuosus var. diehlii, commonly known as  Diehl's milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae). It is used in traditional medicine to promote health and wellness due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating properties. The therapeutic actions of Diehl's milkvetch include its ability to enhance the body's natural defense against infection and disease, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Diehl's milkvetch include isoflavones, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
